audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Annie/Annie/Annie/Skill/Fizz/Fizz/Fizz. Six of seven rows disagreed across the two layers. Annie was also called 'he/his/him' in 16 fields.
audit.why: Annie starts the game with Pyromania available, so levels 1-3 are hers: Disintegrate is 625 range on a 4-second cooldown against your 550 Q, and the fourth cast stuns flat. Level 4-5 is even once Playful/Trickster can answer the proc, and from 6 the shark plus the string beats her once the stun is spent.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved onto the content values with whys rewritten to match each verdict. All 16 misgender findings fixed.
sources: enemyKit P text ('begins the game with Pyromania available')

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and breakdown.spikes claimed the string 'one-shots squishies' with no source.
audit.why: No damage magnitudes exist in either kit's text. The real spike structure is: level 3 pole, level 6 Tibbers adding a second piece of hard CC on a 130-second cooldown, and the first item making the melee trade winnable.
audit.corrected: Both restated on mechanics and real cooldowns.
sources: enemyKit R cd 130/115/100 and hardCC flag

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never once mentioned Molten Shield, which is the ability that decides every extended trade in this lane, and it credited Fizz with an execute he does not have (content.late and whys[6] both said 'Seastone Trident execute').
audit.why: Riot's Molten Shield text: it grants a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and 'damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells' — on a 10-second cooldown. Fizz's whole pattern is Q-dash plus W-empowered autos plus the E slam, so every piece of your combo feeds that reflect while the shield also eats the burst. Fizz's W carries only the autoReset flag; there is no execute and no true damage anywhere in his kit.
audit.corrected: Molten Shield written into tradeGood, phases[2].why, breakdown.late, dosFull[1].d and content.late as the reflect-and-absorb window you wait out. Execute claims replaced with the Seastone Trident bleed. Also stated Pyromania's real trigger — four casts, and a Disintegrate on a minion still counts — so the player counts spells rather than watching HP.
sources: enemyKit E text and shield flag

audit.why: Summon: Tibbers is 130/115/100 at 600 range; Disintegrate 4s, Incinerate 7s, Molten Shield 10s. Those three short cooldowns are exactly how fast she re-stocks the stun, which is the number the player actually needs.
audit.corrected: All written in, framed as the stun-restock clock rather than a list.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED). wants.foe[2] described her as stacking 'mana-free stun procs'.
audit.why: Bodies did not match titles. Pyromania stacks by casting spells, and every one of her spells costs 60-90 mana — there is nothing mana-free about it.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to their titles, and the mana-free claim removed.

notes:
CHART: the full layer read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] matched packet.levelChart exactly (Annie/Annie/Annie/Skill/Fizz/Fizz/Fizz). The full layer was the wrong one, so the six side edits move it onto the content values and carry no paired win[N] edit — win[N] already holds the right value and an edit there would be a no-op the applier rejects. Row 3 (Levels 4-5) already agreed at Skill. After this applies the layers match.

BIGGEST GAP: Molten Shield appeared nowhere on the page — not in cooldowns, not in trading, not in any report entry. It is a 10-second shield that also 'damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells', which is the single worst thing that can happen to a Fizz pattern built on a dash, empowered autos and a slam. I wrote it into five fields.

No suspectNames and no missingInteractions were supplied; packet.defects was empty. The execute error was found by comparing the text against Fizz's own kit: content.late and whys[6] both credited 'Seastone Trident execute', but Fizz's W carries only the autoReset flag and Riot's text describes a bleed.
